activity.notes: Sawlon was saopha of the Shan state of Mohnyin in the early sixteenth century and led a wider Shan confederation. 'Shan States' is too broad for his personal polity, so ATLAS uses Mohnyin. The start of his reign is only given broadly as the 1500s; the earliest 1502 raid may refer to his father, so the start is marked uncertain.

sources.title: Sawlon
sources.citation_text: The biographical entry identifies Sawlon as saopha of Mohnyin and leader of a confederation of Shan states, with his death in 1533 and an uncertain early-sixteenth-century accession.
